name: max_pred_locks_per_page
description: Sets the maximum number of predicate-locked tuples per page before upgrading to a page-level lock.
symptoms: Excessive page-level locking under high contention
tuning_tips: Increase only for high-contention predicate-lock workloads (e.g., SERIALIZABLE isolation with fine-grained conflicts); monitor shared memory usage and lock escalation frequency.
